rows.mappingNote: Exact1542820/ゆうだち/夕立; sudden heavy summer shower.
rows.sourceNote: Afternoon or evening, not evening-only or every evening rain. Older public weather senses are not added to the practical lesson. Broad rain/shower and heavy-rain labels receive direct guards, not a rain-sound clique.

rows.mappingNote: Exact1542750/ゆうひ/夕日; evening/setting sun with public evening-sunlight use.
rows.sourceNote: Sun or its light differs from夕方 time and日の入り event/time, though sunset-related English labels overlap. Preserve raw gloss independently of the public sunlight expansion.
rows.identityNote: Alternative夕陽 sharesゆうひ. Readingせきじつ is restricted to夕日; separate夕陽せきよう2863726 qualifications are not transferred.

rows.mappingNote: Exact1605700/ゆうゆう/悠々; leisurely/composed manner and easy achievement.
rows.sourceNote: Publicと-adverb and attributiveたる constructions, not ordinaryな. Distant/boundless/eternal sense3 is limited recognition-level teaching. Direct calm/ease/extent guards do not establish unrestricted substitution or a transitive clique.

rows.mappingNote: Exact1541690/ゆうりょう/有料; fee-charging status.
rows.sourceNote: Noun/no-adjectival patterns, not automaticな. Paid means a fee is charged, not necessarily payment already completed. Toll-road abbreviation is contextual additional teaching.

rows.mappingNote: Exact1584990/ゆかた/浴衣; light cotton kimono/bathrobe.
rows.sourceNote: Special whole-word reading, not invented individualゆ andかた readings. Recognizedよくい and public湯帷子 history do not change primaryゆかた. Summer and inn uses are not separate identities.

rows.mappingNote: Exact1448600/ゆげ/湯気; steam rising from hot water or food.
rows.sourceNote: KANJIDIC2 native湯ゆ plus on気ケ, voicedげ; native-first mixed reading storedwago. Visible condensed droplets and invisible gaseous water are distinguished without denying ordinarysteam overlap. Unrelated nestedゆけ heading excluded.

rows.mappingNote: Exact1538810/ゆけつ/輸血; blood transfusion.
rows.sourceNote: Whole blood or blood components; both transitive/intransitiveする recorded. Recipientに and輸血を受ける explained. Donation献血 and drawing採血 remain distinct procedures.

rows.mappingNote: Exact1538850/ゆそう/輸送; transport of people or goods.
rows.sourceNote: Not limited to international commerce or postal delivery. Broad transport/send/delivery labels and modal transport comparisons are adjudicated directly; passage-through通過 is not treated as the same sense of Englishtransit.

rows.mappingNote: Exact1538690/ゆだん/油断; inattention/carelessness/unpreparedness.
rows.sourceNote: Intransitiveする; a lapse need not prove a lifelong personality trait or produce an accident. Oil-bowl origin stories remain disputed. Fullぼんやり/ぼうっと and過失 secondary senses inspected.

rows.mappingNote: Exact1571470/ゆでる; kana-primary transitive ichidan cooking verb.
rows.sourceNote: 茹でる, rare煠でる and alternateうでる recognized without changingkana primary metadata. Sense2 treating a swelling with medicinal steam is contrast-only, not food steaming or preparation of medicinal material. Boiling food differs from boiling water;煮る overlap is not an absolute water/seasoning partition.

rows.mappingNote: Exact1612130/ゆのみ/湯飲み; teacup.
rows.sourceNote: Recognized湯のみ/湯呑み/湯呑/湯飲 variants. Expanded湯飲み茶碗2810060 isゆのみぢゃわん. No universal handle/material rule separates everycup term.

rows.mappingNote: Exact1214410/ゆるい/緩い; loose/lax/gentle plus slow/weak/soft uses.
rows.sourceNote: Direct fit, leniency, slope, speed and consistency comparisons use complete old bodies. No transitive import of every soft-texture or weak-flavor guard.
rows.identityNote: Regional sense6 applies to negativeゆるくない, difficult/hard, and is contrast-only. Separateぬるい1183300 spelling overlap does not addlukewarm toゆるい.

rows.mappingNote: Exact1546120/ようがん/溶岩; lava.
rows.sourceNote: Public evidence includes cooled solidified lava. Not undergroundmagma or liquid-only. Rare熔岩 is recognized without a frequency claim for invented collocations.

rows.mappingNote: Exact1545370/ようき/容器; container/receptacle, including packaging use.
rows.sourceNote: 入れ物1587840 andケース overlap. 包装 includes outer wrapping as well as wrapping activity, not action-only. Different identity from homophone陽気.

rows.mappingNote: Exact1546270/ようご/用語; term/terminology and wording/choice of words.
rows.sourceNote: Not technical-jargon-only. Word/term and wording/manner comparisons are sense-specific, not every phrase containing語 orword in English.

rows.mappingNote: Exact1546770/ようし/要旨; gist/main points/summary/abstract.
rows.sourceNote: Main substance rather than all detail. 大体1414470:3 andおよそ1523450:4 are genuine outline/gist comparisons despite approximation-focused older lessons; full families and bodies read.

rows.mappingNote: Exact1545160/ようじ/幼児; ordinary young child and specified Japanese legal category.
rows.sourceNote: Public legal definition is completed age1 until primary school, not universal ordinary/international age bounds. Do not automatically exclude every infant/baby translation or equate every under-18 person with幼児.
rows.identityNote: Separateおさなご1545150 can share幼児 spelling; unrelated homophone用事 is not the mapping.

rows.mappingNote: Exact1545420/ようせき/容積; capacity/volume.
rows.sourceNote: Public entry includes interior capacity and volume of a solid; no absolute interior-only rule against体積1409560. Prescribed headcount定員 shares an Englishcapacity label but is not cubic measurement.

rows.mappingNote: Exact1545250/ようち/幼稚; infancy noun and childish/immature na-adjective/noun.
rows.sourceNote: Critical adjective can describe adults' ideas or methods. Do not transfer its dismissive tone automatically to institutional幼稚園.

rows.sourceNote: Japanese noncompulsory stage age3 until primary school. Do not universalize national arrangements or merge every保育園/保育所/認定こども園 into one institution type.
